-- Schema for database: rschema_0330

CREATE TABLE `user` (
  `id` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `version` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `user_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `user_name_ci` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `password_hash` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `status` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `email_address` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `email_address_ci` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `display_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `display_name_ci` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `locale_tag` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `time_zone` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `date_format_style` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `time_format_style` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `user_identity_key` (
  `id` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `key_scheme` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `key_value` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `user_and_identity_key_association` (
  `user_id` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `id_key_id` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id_key_id`, `user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `user_and_identity_key_association_ibfk_id_key_id` FOREIGN KEY (`id_key_id`) REFERENCES `user_identity_key` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `user_and_identity_key_association_ibfk_user_id` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `schema_0` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `role` (
  `id` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `version` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `role_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `role_name_ci` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `description` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `role_and_role_association` (
  `user_id` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `role_id` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `role_and_role_association_ibfk_role_id` FOREIGN KEY (`role_id`) REFERENCES `role` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `role_and_role_association_ibfk_user_id` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `schema_0` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

Each user has a unique user ID, username, password hash, status, email address, display name, language tag, time zone, date and time format, and other information. Each user can have multiple identity keys, each of which includes an authentication scheme and an identity key value. The system supports the creation and management of roles, and each role has a unique role ID, role name, and description. Relationships are established between users and roles through association tables. A role can be assigned to multiple users, and a user can also have multiple roles. The system records the user's basic information, identity keys, role assignments, and the relationship between users and roles in order to implement permission management and user authentication.
